title: Small reflow, target-size and forced-colours gaps
steps: a11y-scan.cjs reflow at 320 px; axe target-size; forced-colors emulation screenshots.
expected: No horizontal scroll at 320 px; targets ≥ 24×24 px or spaced; buttons keep a visible boundary in Windows High Contrast.
actual: 16 of 36 page states scroll horizontally at 320 px, all by 3 px (header action group with the guest badge). 8 targets under 24 px (password visibility toggle, product page controls). In forced-colours mode the primary 'Sign in' button loses its background and border and reads as plain text.
impact: Minor sideways jiggle on small phones; harder tapping; button affordance lost for high-contrast users.
fix: Allow the header action group to shrink (min-w-0, smaller gap at <360 px); give icon buttons h-11 w-11 hit areas; add `forced-colors:border forced-colors:border-[ButtonText]` to the Button variants.
